components_design.pos_screen: Grid 12 cols layout: Left 7 cols for Customer selector + Catalog filter + Interactive Product Cards with availability status badges. Right 5 cols for Checkout Summary, Rental Duration Picker, Security Deposit Input, Payment Method (Cash, QRIS, Transfer), and Instant Receipt/Invoice Trigger.
components_design.invoice_print: A4 printable format with Aurora Sewa Kebaya logo header, Customer measurements breakdown, Rental period (Tanggal Ambil & Tanggal Kembali), Payment breakdown (Sewa, Denda/Deposit, Sisa Bayar), Syarat & Ketentuan Rental, and Signature blocks.

instructions_to_main_agent: All React code should be written in JavaScript (.js / .jsx format) compatible with standard React 18 + Tailwind setup.

Every key button, input, tab, navigation link, card, and interactive element MUST have a unique descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='pos-add-to-cart-button', data-testid='katalog-filter-category').
Ensure all monetary numbers are formatted consistently in Indonesian Rupiah format: Rp 500.000.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers, popovers, select menus, or dropdowns. Always specify bg-white or backdrop-blur with white tint.
Support full real-time database state (or state hooks) with reactive updates across Dashboard KPI cards, POS cart, Booking calendar, Rental checkouts/returns, and Reports.
Maintain high aesthetic standards: soft pink highlights (#FFF5F8, #E83E8C), refined typography, clear status pill badges, and generous spacing.
